title: mimiCRY
description: A slow burn horror modpack, involving mimics(oh wow).
body:
Most modern horror packs are just malware or run from 129 dwellers. Mine is lowkey diffrent.
This is a horror pack that adds more than a few creatures and cryptids to your world. 
For example, the knocker, AND the ability for players to knock on your doors. vc, AND the mimicked mod. Its function is to scare you without 1000 constant jumpscares every five seconds. I didn't write this with AI so you can also credit me on actually writing this. Anyway, best played with your friends, and as a challenge. 
Also, I cannot stress enough, please don't play this if your pc isnt decent it will crash, possibly your whole pc.
